items.title: Dave Rivello interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rochester, New York, January 11, 2012
items.q: I just did a big project last summer for John Nugent, strings from the RPO and harp and jazz rhythm section, all in jazz standards. So John played that during the jazz festival and it was my first conducting with the baton experience in Eastman Theater

ctx.x: I do. I just did a big project last summer for John Nugent, strings from the RPO and harp and jazz rhythm section, all in jazz standards. So John played that during the jazz festival and it was my first conducting with the baton experience in Eastman Theater and two thousand people. It’s supposed to start running on PBS one of these days. They filmed it to be broadcast. So that, and anytime I get the chance to write for studio orchestra — like I had mentioned Jim Doser, and every year he puts together a studio…
Do you have any questions, Alanna? Do you have goals for five, ten years from now?
